Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1244
Claimant:
Heather Curtis
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
08/08/2023
The claim was reported by the insured's attorney, who advised that the insured was rear-ended at a traffic light and
has since been diagnosed with a concussion. The file was opened and an acknowledgment letter was sent to
counsel.
09/07/2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage is in force on the date of loss. Requested the police
report, which lists the claimant as a passenger in the vehicle at the time of the impact.
09/23/2023
Obtained the police report and two independent witness statements. Both witnesses and the other driver describe the
collision in the same way as the insured, and the scnee photos are consistent with that account.
10/11/2023
Reviewed the repair estimate and photos of the vehicle. The rear damage is consistent with the impact described by
all parties.
11/02/2023
Received the initial medical summary from counsel. The reported concussion is a plausible injury for a colilsion of this
type, and treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this diagnosis.
11/28/2023
Requested prior medical records from the claimant's providers. The records show ongoing treatment for the same
condition before the crash, and most of the current complaints appear to originate from that earlier history.
01/06/2024
The insured provided a recorded statement with additional details not included in the first report. The core account of
the collision did not change.
01/31/2024
A neighbor contacted the office and said the vehicle looked damaged several weeks before the stated date of loss.
No prior damage is known from our file or the repair history, so the statement is bieng noted but not yet verified.
02/18/2024
Spoke with counsel to request clarification of the prior treatment history and the timeline of the neighbor's
observation. Counsel stated that the eariler condition was resolved before the crash.
02/20/2024
File remains open pending review of the complete medical records and the neighbor's statement. Next step is a
referral to the claims supervisor for evaluation of the bodily injury component.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
